scope: finite largest-object directional recoloring grammar, optionally followed by rot90/fliplr/flipud; synthetic held-out scene styles, not ARC/S6 or open-ended invention
unit_of_inference: independent acquisition run, with all three arms paired within run

learning_curve.utility: For each arm and run, arithmetic mean of exact evaluation accuracy after each of the three teacher queries; normalized discrete AUC, no zero-query endpoint or trapezoidal weighting
learning_curve.pairing: Reuse the same evaluation inputs at every prefix; cases and prefixes remain nested within one acquisition run, never independent replicates
learning_curve.feedback: Prefix predictions use only the current frozen surviving hypotheses; evaluation labels and correctness never enter subsequent selection or learning
learning_curve.final_endpoint: Final accuracy and final regressions remain safeguards; final accuracy gain is descriptive only and is not a V2 superiority claim

selection.adaptive: maximum number of disagreeing live hypothesis pairs; stable input-order tie break; no labels or witness
selection.random: uniform input index from a separate deterministic public selection stream
selection.sequential: first input in an IID, difficulty-unordered pool
selection.teacher: external to actor; selected acquisition label only, one query per round per arm

budget.shared: execute each hypothesis on every public input exactly once per paired run; immutable prediction table shared by all arms, physically charged once
budget.matched: identical actual hypothesis prediction tables, three label queries and full label-comparison opportunities; identical evaluation prediction/adjudication opportunities after every prefix; zero arm-specific hypothesis executions
budget.unmatched: actual selector overhead is counted, never padded or declared equal; bounded-overhead gate can fail
budget.comparison: per-arm standalone-equivalent cost = common preparation + that arm's actual work; physical total = common preparation + sum of arm work
budget.units: logical operations including rendered cells, DSL work, prediction serialization, label comparisons, selection, teacher copies and evaluation; not FLOPs, wall time or joules

acceptance.bootstrap: deterministic paired-run percentile bootstrap; primary utility, absolute total-cost delta and relative overhead jointly resampled; all prefixes and cases remain within their run; final accuracy comparison is descriptive
acceptance.promotion: none; closure success requires every gate, including cost; do not tune on confirmation

preexecution_design_revision: V1 replaced zero incremental cost with at most 5 percent total-work overhead after coordinator static review within authorized scope, before V1 execution. That numeric threshold was not an explicit user instruction. The earlier change was not post-result threshold tuning.

v2_revision.authorized: 2026-10-10, after audited development r1 and before any confirmation execution
v2_revision.reason: Development r1: all arms 16/16 final successes across four independent runs; eleven of twelve arms identified a single hypothesis after one query and the remaining arm after two. Final accuracy gain was zero; V1's final-superiority objective was not demonstrated and is refuted for this observed development cohort.
v2_revision.change: Measure accuracy at every existing query prefix and gate learning utility rather than claim improved final precision. This is an explicitly outcome-informed development revision, not V1 preregistration or confirmation success.
v2_revision.preserved: 32 paired confirmation runs, three teacher queries, grammar, pools, generator, selection algorithms, seed partition and reserved uninspected confirmation seeds, work ceiling and five-percent overhead bounds
v2_revision.custody: Retain archived V1 sources, contract, development report and valid audit; freeze V2 before new checks/campaigns. No seed search or pool redesign. No claim that V2 will pass.
